about-outline: V domike is a warm family VPN client. Profiles and per-app rules are stored only on your device. Network connections use the open Shadowsocks protocol.
add-access-key-dialog-help-text: Ask your VPN administrator for an access key.
auto-connect-dialog-detail: Unless you disconnect from the profile, V domike will automatically connect next time you restart your device.
basic-access-content: Basic Access is an alternative way to connect to the open internet. It offers limited protection of your internet traffic without using a VPN server.
basic-access-splash-title: A New Way to Get Online
connection-confirm-checkbox-label: Allow the app to connect me to the internet with limited protection
contact-view-exit-billing: The app does not collect payment. Please contact the person who gave you the access key.
contact-view-exit-cannot-add-server: Please contact the person who gave you the access key for help adding a server.
contact-view-exit-connection: Please contact the person who gave you the access key for help connecting to the server.
contact-view-exit-no-server: The app does not distribute free or paid access keys. Ask your VPN administrator for one.
contact-view-exit-open-ticket: We are currently experiencing high support volume and appreciate your patience. Please do not submit a new request for this concern. If you have additional information to provide, please reply to the initial email about this request.
contact-view-intro: Tell us how we can help. Please explain your issue in detail and do not enter personal information that is not requested below.
contact-view-issue-cannot-add-server: I am having trouble adding a server using my access key
contact-view-issue-connection: I am having trouble connecting to my VPN server
contact-view-issue-managing: I need assistance managing my VPN server or helping others connect to it
contact-view-issue-performance: My internet access is slow while connected to my VPN server
contact-view-open-ticket: Do you have an open ticket for this issue?
dns-select-description: Basic Access protects you from DNS attacks. Choose which DNS over HTTPS server you’d like to use.
error-connection-configuration: Invalid configuration. Screenshot the error details and send them to your access key provider.
error-connection-configuration-fetch: Failed to download the server configuration. Screenshot the error details and send them to your access key provider.
error-connection-proxy: Failed to connect. Please check your internet connectivity, then screenshot the error details and send them to your access key provider.
error-feedback-submission: Sorry, we were unable to submit your feedback. Please check that you are connected to the internet and try again.
error-invalid-access-key: Invalid access key. Please try again, or submit feedback for help.
error-server-incompatible: Sorry, this access key is not compatible with this version of the app.
error-timeout: Something seems to be taking longer than expected. Quitting and restarting may help. If this happens again, please submit feedback.
error-unexpected: Sorry, an unexpected error occurred. Quitting and restarting may help. If this happens again, please submit feedback.
feedback-thanks: Thanks for helping us improve! We love hearing from you.
non-system-vpn-warning-detail: Most browsers connect automatically with the VPN, some do not.
outline-plugin-error-admin-permissions: The VPN needs admin permissions in order to be initialized. If you don't have admin permissions, please try again after restarting your computer or ask your system administrator for help.
outline-plugin-error-antivirus: It seems like your antivirus software is preventing us from successfully connecting.
outline-plugin-error-invalid-server-cred: It seems like your access key is not valid. If this happens again, please contact the person who gave it to you.
outline-plugin-error-routing-tables: We were not able to configure your routing tables successfully. If this happens again, please contact us.
outline-plugin-error-server-unreachable: We can’t seem to connect to your server. Please check that you are connected to the internet and try again.
outline-plugin-error-system-configuratio: Sorry, it looks like the app is not properly installed. Please try installing it again.
outline-plugin-error-udp-forwarding-not-: It seems like this server doesn’t support UDP forwarding. If this happens again, please contact the person who gave you access.
outline-plugin-error-unsupported-routing: It seems like another VPN is active. Please disconnect it and try again.
outline-plugin-error-vpn-permission-not-: The app needs your permission to set up a VPN connection to the server. Please try again.
outline-services-installation-confirmati: We will initialize the VPN, which may require admin permissions. Would you like to proceed?
outline-services-installation-failed: Unfortunately we are not able to initialize the VPN.
outline-services-installed: The VPN has been successfully initialized. Please try again to connect to the server.
privacy-text: Some technical information is sent if you submit feedback, if there’s an app error or crash, or if your server administrator opts in to share anonymous server usage data.
privacy-title: V domike does not collect your personal information
proxyless-confirm-dialog-content:
This key uses an alternative way to connect to the open internet. It offers limited protection of your internet traffic. This approach will make it harder for outside observers to see what you connect to online, without the use of a VPN (proxy) server.

To learn more, contact the person who gave you this access key.
server-add-instructions: Copy and paste an access key to add a server.
server-add-invalid: {openLine}Invalid access key.{closeLine}Enter a valid access key (ss://) to add a server.

server-proxyless-info-dialog-content:
This access key offers access to the open internet with limited protection.

With this key—
  • The app will not send any of your traffic through a VPN server.
  • Alternative methods will be applied to make the traffic less identifiable to outside observers.
server-split-tunneling-info-dialog-conte:
This key offers limited protection when connecting to the open internet. The app will bypass the VPN server in certain cases.

  • Some connections will go directly to the internet.
  • Other connections will use an alternative method that is harder for outside observers to identify.

support-form-email-invalid: You have entered an invalid format.
